verdict.rationale: The README documents one-line installs with the open `skills` CLI (`npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills`, with `--skill` for a single skill), a non-interactive install-all path for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and a first-party `yy skills install` command. A plugin/marketplace manifest bundles the canonical skills. missing for 10: explicit documentation that installed skills are active in the next agent session, independent or hands-on corroboration of the install flow.
